title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Windows Desktop Build 279
highlights: Persistent Missing Field Red Outlines: When saving an invoice, quotation, or job sheet, any empty or invalid required field (Customer Name, Mobile Number, Items list, Address for GST/₹50k, GSTIN) remains highlighted with a sharp red border and soft red warning fill until filled.
Item Table Missing Alert: Prominently warns with a red border and missing product alert box directly on the items table when saving an empty bill.
Calendar Real-Date Festival Engine: Test festival setup is permanently hidden; 3D celebrations and audio trigger exclusively on authentic calendar festival dates and shop owner birthday.
Dedicated Windows Update Stream: Pure Windows desktop updates that never download or conflict with Android mobile APK packages.
fixes: Added persistent red border (#DC2626) and soft red background (#FEF2F2) on missing mandatory fields across Desktop Invoice and Job Sheet.
Added red warning banner to empty invoice items grid on save attempt.
Fixed mobile number validation in Job Sheet.
